# PCSpecialist Belgium live Recoil layer — SRC-0350

## Proven live transactions

- Recoil III Intel: 275HX, RTX 5080, 32GB Kingston DDR5-6400 (2x16), Samsung 990 Pro 1TB, Mini-LED P3, Belgian keyboard, no OS: **€3315 incl. VAT/delivery**. Liquid cooler +€160.
- Recoil 16 AMD: 9955HX3D, RTX 5080, 32GB (2x16), Samsung 990 Pro 1TB, Mini-LED P3, Belgian keyboard, no OS: **€3041**. Liquid cooler +€160.
- Recoil IV: 290HX Plus, RTX 5090, 32GB, Samsung 990 Pro 1TB, Mini-LED P3, Belgian keyboard, no OS: **€3752**. The live configurator exposed RTX 5090 only at check time.

Intel III exposes 2.5GbE and TB4; AMD exposes 2.5GbE but only 2x 10Gbps USB-C; IV exposes only Gigabit LAN plus TB4. All have separate DC-in, two M.2 and two SO-DIMM slots.

All live baskets exposed only Gold coverage: 3Y labor, 2Y parts and 2Y collection. The general warranty page explicitly describes Platinum as 3Y parts/labor/collection, but no Platinum option or price appeared in these configurators. Cooling hardware in year three is therefore not transaction-proven covered.
